dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Today we're going to learn first aid.
dialogue.reading: təˈdeɪ wɪr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈlɜːrn ˈfɜːrst ˈeɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What should we do first in an emergency?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ʃʊd wiː ˈduː ˈfɜːrst ɪn ən ɪˈmɜːrdʒənsi?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: If someone is hurt, call for help. Don't move them.
dialogue.reading: ɪf ˈsʌmwʌn ɪz ˈhɜːrt, ˈkɔːl fər ˈhɛlp. ˈdoʊnt ˈmuːv ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: If they feel dizzy, help them lie down.
dialogue.reading: ɪf ðeɪ ˈfiːl ˈdɪzi, ˈhɛlp ðɛm ˈlaɪ ˈdaʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What should we do if there's a lot of blood?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ʃʊd wiː ˈduː ɪf ðɛrz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈblʌd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Press on the cut with a clean towel. If you have a bandage, put it on the cut.
dialogue.reading: ˈprɛs ɑːn ðə ˈkʌt wɪð ə ˈkliːn ˈtaʊəl. ɪf juː ˈhæv ə ˈbændɪdʒ, ˈpʊt ɪt ɑːn ðə ˈkʌt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: If it's serious, get medical help. Don't wait!
dialogue.reading: ɪf ɪts ˈsɪriəs, ˈɡɛt ˈmɛdɪkəl ˈhɛlp. ˈdoʊnt ˈweɪt!
